turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Good morning. Please pass your passport and I-20 form through the window.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Good morning. Here's my passport and my documents.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: I see you've been working full-time for three years. Why leave a stable job right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I like my job, but Korean brands are going global fast, and I need stronger business skills to work on that when I come back.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Graduate school in the US is quite expensive. How are you funding your tuition and living costs?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm using my own savings, and my parents are helping with the rest.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: With an American master's degree, you could easily stay and find a job there. How do I know you'll come back?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My goal has always been to build my career here in Seoul. Staying in the US just isn't part of my plan.

turns.speaker: counterpart
turns.text: Everything looks in order. Your visa is approved, and you'll get your passport back in a few days.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you so much. Have a great day!
